assessment: This study presents important findings on the early development of cardiac and respiratory interoceptive sensitivity based on an investigation of infants aged 3, 9 and 18 months and on extensive statistical analyses. The evidence supporting the conclusions are convincing although the research faced technical challenges that limited part of the findings interpretation. This study will be of significant interest to developmental psychologists and neuroscientists working on interoception and its influence on socio-cognitive development.
affiliation: Inserm Unité NeuroDiderot, Université Paris Cité
